about.commitment: Our commitment to human rights and social development

areas.title: Our areas of work
areas.intro: Six complementary areas guide ADIVAH's commitment to a fairer, more inclusive and more peaceful Haitian society.

human-rights.text: Protecting the fundamental rights and freedoms of every person, and promoting respect for them in Haiti.

social-justice.text: Acting against inequality and discrimination so that everyone is treated with fairness and respect.

community.text: Supporting sustainable development by placing communities at the heart of the solutions that concern them.

education.text: Raising awareness of everyone's rights and responsibilities so that all people can act with knowledge.

protection.text: Paying particular attention to those most at risk, so that their dignity and safety are preserved.
points: Attention to those most at risk

citizenship.text: Encouraging all citizens to take part in public life and in the decisions that affect their future.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains how the website handles the information you send.
privacy.collectText: Forms collect only what you enter: name, email address, message and, if you wish, phone number and organization. Your IP address is not stored with your message; it is kept temporarily in memory to limit abuse.
privacy.useText: This information is used only to respond to your request. It is neither sold nor used for advertising, and only authorized administrators can access it.
privacy.cookiesText: The site uses no advertising or tracking tools. Your language choice is kept in your browser. A session cookie is used only for signed-in administrators.
privacy.rightsText: You can request access to your information or its deletion by using the contact form.
privacy.safetyText: This website is not yet a secure reporting channel. If your situation is sensitive, do not send details that could expose you or other people.
